messages.subject: upload binary file in Shiny server app
parts: So, if one wanted to have a Shiny server app that would allow the user to upload a binary file - say, a shapefile - how would one go about it?  Do I need to learn Node.js and incorporate it into my server.R, or.. ?

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: Re: upload binary file in Shiny server app
parts:
Shiny's fileInput component will allow the user to upload any file to the server regardless of type. 

Also R has a readBin function (http://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/base/functions/readBin) which can be used to read binary files. So sounds like theoretically there is no need to go out of R. However I am not familiar with the specifics so I can't comment further.
